AstroCapture uses the unmodified Qt 6 shared libraries and QML modules.
Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd and other contributors.
These libraries and their use are covered by the GNU LGPL version 3.
The LGPL and the accompanying GPL text are included in Qt-LGPL-3.0.txt
and Qt-GPL-3.0.txt. Module-specific third-party notices remain in Qt's source.

The Linux distribution build uses Qt 6.9.3. Corresponding upstream source:
https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.9/6.9.3/single/qt-everywhere-src-6.9.3.tar.xz
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/

The AppImage can be extracted with --appimage-extract. Its shared Qt libraries
are in the resulting AppDir/usr/lib directory; compatible modified libraries
can replace them in this extracted copy. Run AppRun to use the extracted copy.
